q1_issues.issue: "the Senate" is a capitalized common noun used as the referent's only label, which the instruction set treats as a common noun by default (definite handling, NO Name atom); the parse emits a Name atom and, consequently, never types the referent at all.

"the Senate's efforts" is an act noun whose genitive names its underlying subject, which the instruction set assigns the noun's own subject role rather than Possession — "Possession for an argument asserts a relation the text never states".

(Agent sk_force_1 senate) asserts a forcer the sentence never names: the infinitive's subject is unstated, and the control rule that copies a controller in is for verbs, not for a noun's genitive reaching into a noun-complement infinitive.

The include event (statements 8-10) is stated inside the complement of "said" yet asserted at top level; the seal-projection table lets only Member/Name typing of definite/named referents and definitional decomposition out of an attitude seal.

The same leak for the purpose oblique and the force/return events (statements 11-16) — P-internal restrictors that the table explicitly keeps sealed — so the parse asserts as fact the whole "efforts to force the Democrats to return" complex that the sentence only reports Perry as backing.

"the Democrats" is a capitalized plural kind-word label, which the instruction set makes a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word; the parse emits a group typed `democrat` and no Name atom.

q2_gaps: a non-restrictive parenthetical inside a reported complement (", including the fines,") — the seal-projection rules say nothing about whether a reporter's parenthetical aside sitting syntactically inside P is sealed with P or asserted as the reporter's own claim

a capitalized plural label whose word genuinely IS the members' kind ("the Democrats") — the Name-only plural rule is a mechanical casing cue whose stated rationale ("the members need not be wrens") does not apply, leaving the type atom either mandatory or forbidden
notes: The attitude shape itself is right — say reified with Experiencer, the complement sealed under Theme with no top-level predication of P, "he" resolved to perry, present-tense "backs" left untensed, include treated as a reduced relative with a stative-transitive Agent, and the object controller placed only inside the embedded return event. The damage is in what escapes the seal: three atoms are inside it and roughly ten atoms of P's own content sit outside as asserted fact.
